references.text: The same chapter describes that whoever touches the bed of a person with a discharge must wash their clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
Whoever sits on something that an unclean person has sat on must wash their clothes and bathe, and be unclean until evening.
Whoever touches the body of a person with a discharge must wash their clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
Similar purification rules apply to whoever touches a woman's bed or objects during her uncleanness.
General rule regarding uncleanness until evening and washing of clothes for anyone who touches or carries unclean things.
Whoever carries a carcass must wash their clothes and be unclean until evening.
Whoever gathers the ashes from the red heifer must wash their clothes and be unclean until evening.
Rule concerning uncleanness until evening and washing of clothes in connection with the water for purification.
Whoever eats an animal that died naturally or was torn apart must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
